title: Google releases security updates for Chrome
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-385.12.07.20: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – Google Releases Security Updates for Chrome
leadParagraph: Google has released Chrome version 87.0.4280.88 for Windows, Mac, and Linux.
contentHtml:
Google has released Chrome version 87.0.4280.88 for Windows, Mac, and Linux.

This version addresses vulnerabilities that an attacker could exploit to take control of an affected system.

It is encouraged that users and administrators review and apply the necessary updates.

For further information and support, please visit:
Chrome Release
